evals.name: create-python-project
evals.prompt: Create a Python project structure with standard directories and configuration files, including pytest setup and GitHub Actions CI
evals.expected_output: A complete project structure with src/, tests/, docs/, scripts/ directories, requirements.txt, setup.py, pyproject.toml, pytest.ini, and .github/workflows/ci.yml

evals.name: create-typescript-project
evals.prompt: Create a TypeScript project structure with standard directories and configuration files
evals.expected_output: A complete project structure with src/, tests/, docs/, scripts/ directories, package.json, tsconfig.json, and .github/workflows/ci.yml

evals.name: check-project-structure
evals.prompt: Check if the current project structure is complete and suggest any missing directories or files
evals.expected_output: An analysis of the current project structure with recommendations for missing standard directories and files
